source_qualified_name.description: QualifiedName of the calling or importing symbol.

target_qualified_name.description: QualifiedName of the called or imported symbol.

edge_type.description: Relationship type: calls or imports. The inherits type is not emitted in schema v1.

Edge.description: A directed relationship between two symbols.

file_path.description: Workspace-relative path of the file that failed.

error_code.description: Stable machine-readable error code. Consumers may branch on this value.

message.description: Human-readable error description. Not stable across binary versions.

byte_offset.description: Byte position of the first error node. Absent when not applicable.

ParseError.description: A per-file parse failure or warning surfaced in the document rather than as a fatal exit.

name.description: Short display name without file path prefix.

file_path.description: Workspace-relative file path with forward-slash separators on all platforms.

symbol_type.description: Kind of code construct: function, class, or module.

line_start.description: 1-based start line. Absent for module symbols.

line_end.description: 1-based end line (inclusive). Absent for module symbols.

Symbol.description: A single code symbol extracted from a source file.

schema_version.description: Output schema version. Always present. Current value: 1.0.

parser_version.description: Semver of the codeweaver binary that produced this output.

parsed_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of when the parse run started.

file_count.description: Number of files for which parse was attempted (total input). Equals files_parsed + files_errored.

symbols.description: Array of extracted code symbols, sorted by qualified_name.

edges.description: Array of relationships between symbols, sorted by (source, target, type). The 'inherits' edge_type is not emitted in schema v1.

deleted_files.description: File paths deleted since last sync. Always [] in binary output; populated by the plugin from its SQLite state.

parse_errors.description: Per-file parse failures. Absent when all files parsed without errors.

dry_run.description: Present and true only when --dry-run was passed.

files_validated.description: Count of files validated in --dry-run mode.

description: Top-level JSON document emitted by codeweaver parse. Consumers branch on schema_version for schema evolution.
